title: 5100033: reviewed outer focal-pedal area product (arXiv k605,a / published k606)
body:
## Exact result and source scope
Proves the phase invariance of the product of the two **signed focal-pedal areas of the outer tangent polygon** for every odd primitive elliptic-billiard period, including primitive star turning numbers, in a strictly nested nondegenerate confocal ellipse pair.

**Edition warning:** this is **k605,a in arXiv:2004.12497v11, Table 7, p. 9**, renamed **k606 in the published Table 7, p. 349**. Published k605 is the different original-orbit pedal product. The proof uses projections onto outer side lines, not the original billiard chords.

## Proof and independent review
The explicit focal foot map has two adjacent simple poles with collinear opposite residues. Their possible double-pole area coefficient cancels. Reflection and imaginary anti-periodicity on the reduced torus then force complementary half-period zeros; odd period makes exchanging foci exactly that half-period shift.

- Independent reviewer: 9,303 exact controls and 4,941 separate 85-digit comparisons, including 27 complex pole cases
- Author replay is byte-identical; finite/numerical checks support the universal proof rather than replace it

The sole review correction was the arXiv edition date: 29 October 2020. The proof bytes are unchanged; the earlier manifest and correction history are retained.

## Credit and status
